title: SpaceX’s 13th Starship test flight has launched.
summary: After last week’s launch attempt misfired and a scheduled attempt Thursday was postponed due to weather, the 13th flight test launched just before 7PM ET on Friday. Update: Updated to note that the vehicle has launched.
